verdict.rationale: Google's own googleapis organization publishes MCP Toolbox for Databases, an open-source MCP server, and the probe identifies it as BigQuery's official MCP server. However, the evidence never explicitly states BigQuery support, its tools, or how to connect an agent. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the server supports BigQuery, documented BigQuery tools and agent connection/setup steps, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: MCP Toolbox for Databases is an open source MCP server for databases.
official MCP server documented at https://github.com/googleapis/mcp-toolbox
